question: What constitutes the purification mantra addressed to the lady of the gods?
premises: This utterance forms a purification mantra.
The instruction is addressed to the goddess.
inference: Having uttered the fire-consort syllable, one completes the purification mantra, O lady of the gods.
plain_english: Having uttered the fire-consort syllable, this is the purification mantra, O lady of the gods.
